phases.goal: 기존 동작을 바꾸지 않는 typed policy compiler와 exhaustive consumer inventory를 구축한다.

phases.title: Retained server model shadow and driver lease
phases.goal: 기존 headless commit chain을 full retained checkpoint, fact ledger와 explicit driver lease로 확장해 shadow parity를 증명한다.

phases.title: Single-authority promotion and rollback epoch
phases.goal: parity를 통과한 제한 session만 single responder epoch로 승격하고 ordered rollback을 보장한다.

phases.title: Fair delivery scheduler and ACK credit
phases.goal: per-client/per-session ordering과 server-owned encoded-byte credit로 flood session과 slow client를 격리한다.

phases.title: Hidden dataGap and authoritative reveal recovery
phases.goal: authority commit 뒤 hidden delivery만 생략하고 gap/reveal을 full retained checkpoint로 수렴시킨다.
